title: A study on Type-2 isomorphic circulant graphs. Part 3: 384 pairs of Type-2 isomorphic circulant graphs $C_{32}(R)$
summary: This study is the $3^{rd}$ part of a detailed study on Type-2 isomorphic circulant graphs having ten parts \cite{v2-1}-\cite{v2-10} and is a continuation of Part 2. Here, we obtain all the 384 pairs of Type-2 isomorphic circulant graphs of order 32.
